periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented at an approximately 80-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated ellipsoidal shape with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering is visible, with the inferior portion of the patch being narrower than the superior portion, creating a teardrop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band follows a broad, smooth U-shaped curvature across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is vertically thick at the lateral flanks, occupying nearly the entire shoulder region before transitioning into the forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned laterally on the crown with a wide gap of white fur separating the medial edges.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior contours of the ears are highly smooth and semicircular without visible flattening or irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: The fur on the lower lumbar and pelvic regions exhibits a distinct brownish-tan discoloration compared to the white fur of the upper cranium and neck.
